method.unit: Each error-bearing trace contributes one flow. Repeated engineering errors within a trace are consolidated so long traces do not dominate.
method.error: The first strongest explicit shell/Python failure is classified into four descriptive error families; one manually checked source-code false positive is excluded.
method.handling: Audited Code error recovery, Forced return to GUI, and Stalled engineering annotations determine recovery. Traces without a coded recovery are separated into completed and unresolved outcomes.
method.landing: The trace's mutually exclusive coded delivery-evidence category.
